title: storefront
description: Discover Algerian COD stores on Mystoq, or manage your own: products, prices, shipping/fraud tools.
summary: Discover Algerian COD stores on Mystoq, or manage your own: products, prices, shipping/fraud tools.
offersHint: Discover Algerian COD stores on Mystoq, or manage your own: products, prices, shipping/fraud tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mystoq.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_stores
toolsPreview.description: Search the public Mystoq store directory (Algerian online shops). Filter by keyword (store name), wilaya, or plan. Returns store name, wilaya, storefront URL and plan tier. Public business listings only — no merchant personal data.

toolsPreview.name: get_store
toolsPreview.description: Get a public Mystoq store by its slug: name, wilaya, storefront URL, plan tier and member-since. Public info only.

toolsPreview.name: list_plans
toolsPreview.description: List Mystoq subscription plans with monthly/yearly/lifetime prices (DZD) — useful to answer "how much does Mystoq cost".

toolsPreview.name: platform_stats
toolsPreview.description: Mystoq network statistics: number of active stores and wilayas covered.

toolsPreview.name: cod_profit
toolsPreview.description: Compute true CAC and net cash-on-delivery profit for an Algerian online store, accounting for the return/refusal rate. Returns base and confirmation-call scenarios.

toolsPreview.name: yalidine_delivery
toolsPreview.description: Estimate delivery success/return rate and typical delivery time for a destination wilaya in Algeria (region-based network estimate).

toolsPreview.name: order_risk
toolsPreview.description: Score the fraud/return risk of an Algerian COD order from its signals (phone, history, etc.) — Mystoq FakeShield logic.

toolsPreview.name: create_store
toolsPreview.description: Register a NEW Mystoq store (tenant). Returns the store id, slug and an access token. No auth needed. WRITE.

toolsPreview.name: create_product
toolsPreview.description: Create a product in the authenticated merchant's store. Requires Bearer token. WRITE.

toolsPreview.name: set_price
toolsPreview.description: Update a product's price (and optional compare_price) in the authenticated store. Requires Bearer token. WRITE.

toolsPreview.name: publish
toolsPreview.description: Publish a product (set status=active) so it shows on the storefront. Requires Bearer token. WRITE.

toolsPreview.name: delete_product
toolsPreview.description: Delete a product from the authenticated store (reversible cleanup — used by the agent's ephemeral live-demo). Requires Bearer token; only the owner's own product. WRITE/DESTRUCTIVE.
